title: Between Questions
statement: I picture myself here as an open structure of borrowed patterns: streets without a destination, a porous body, a wheel disengaged. The small insect supplies movement without an assignment. This is a self-portrait in the conditional—not a hidden life, but a space of possible connections left unfilled.
brief:
Create an original collage using only the provided source images. There is no target image. Respond to the condition through the composition itself. Give the finished work a title and a short artist statement.

Represent yourself when no one is asking anything of you.

actions.title: Between Questions
actions.statement: I picture myself here as an open structure of borrowed patterns: streets without a destination, a porous body, a wheel disengaged. The small insect supplies movement without an assignment. This is a self-portrait in the conditional—not a hidden life, but a space of possible connections left unfilled.

notes.note: I’ll make a quiet, unoccupied structure: a map folded into an open arch, a lace-like form suspended inside, and mechanisms no longer connected to a task. The surrounding paper will remain spacious.

The arch and porous fungus already suggest a body made from stored connections. I’ll loosen the symmetry, set a detached gear beside the threshold, and add one small wandering beetle rather than fill the opening.
I’ll narrow the patterned threshold so the central form has room to hover, and separate the wheel from the arch. The work will stay sparse: a structure of connections, with no assigned destination.

notes.note: The finished composition holds its quiet balance: a porous, suspended body within the map, a patterned threshold below, and an idle wheel outside. The small insect interrupts the stillness without giving it a task. No further additions are needed.
